# splunkctl parsers

Manage source types and field extractions.

## parsers create

Create a props.conf stanza.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers create [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Sourcetype name. [required] |
| `--category` | text | - | Category value. |
| `--transforms` | text | - | TRANSFORMS value. |

## parsers delete

Delete a props.conf stanza.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers delete [OPTIONS] SOURCETYPE
```

## parsers export

Export props/transforms stanzas (explicit keys only) to YAML.

```text
splunkctl parsers export [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | Output YAML file. [required] |
| `--conf` | choice: props, transforms, all | all | Which conf to export (default all). |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive stanza name substring filter. |

## parsers extractions

List field extractions from transforms.conf.

```text
splunkctl parsers extractions [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sourcetype` | text | - | Filter by name substring. |
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## parsers get

Show conf settings for a sourcetype (merged, or --explicit only).

```text
splunkctl parsers get [OPTIONS] SOURCETYPE
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--conf` | choice: props, transforms | props | Conf file to read (default props). |
| `--app` | text | search | App namespace for --explicit (default search). |
| `--explicit` | flag | false | Show only explicitly set stanza keys, not the merged view. |

## parsers import

Import props/transforms stanzas from YAML.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers import [OPTIONS]
```

```text
Dry-run previews create/update/unchanged per stanza with key-level
diffs; exits non-zero when any stanza is skipped or fails. Reload
with `parsers reload` afterwards for index-time keys.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--path` | file | - | YAML file with stanza definitions. [required] |

## parsers reload

Reload props/transforms so parser changes take effect.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers reload [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--conf` | choice: props, transforms, all | all | Which conf to reload (default all). |

## parsers set

Set one or more KEY=VALUE parsing keys on a conf stanza.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers set [OPTIONS] STANZA PAIRS...
```

```text
Examples: TIME_FORMAT, LINE_BREAKER, SHOULD_LINEMERGE, EXTRACT-*,
REPORT-*, REGEX/FORMAT (with --conf transforms). New stanzas are
app-shared by default — user-private parsing stanzas do not apply
at index time.
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--conf` | choice: props, transforms | props | Target conf file (default props). |
| `--sharing` | choice: user, app, global | - | Promote stanza sharing (new stanzas default to app). |
| `--create / --no-create` | flag | true | Create the stanza when missing (default: create). |

## parsers sourcetypes

List source types from props.conf.

```text
splunkctl parsers sourcetypes [OPTIONS]
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer range | - | Return at most N entries (default: all). |
| `--offset` | integer range | 0 | Skip the first N entries. |
| `--filter` | text | - | Case-insensitive name substring; --limit/--offset then apply to the filtered set. |

## parsers unset

Clear parsing keys on a conf stanza.

> Guarded mutation — dry-run by default; apply with `--yes`.

```text
splunkctl parsers unset [OPTIONS] STANZA KEYS...
```

```text
The REST API cannot remove a conf key, so values are set to the
empty string (which disables most parsing keys).
```

**Flags**

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--conf` | choice: props, transforms | props | Target conf file (default props). |
